title: ‘Vacate Balochistan, PoK And Sindh Or …’, Baloch Leader Warns Pakistan On Vijay Diwas
description: On the occasion of Vijay Diwas, commemorating the 1971 India-Pakistan war, Baloch leader Mir Yar Baloch has warned Pakistan, calling on it to vacate Balochistan, Pakistan-occupied Kashmir and Sindh. Referring to Pakistan’s historic surrender, he said that history is poised to repeat itself and that Islamabad could once again face a humiliating defeat.

title: South Asian States Seek Cooperation-Without India
description: A proposed Bangladesh-China-Pakistan nexus could raise concerns in New Delhi.

title: Omar Abdullah: Navigating the Turbulent Waters of Indo-Pak Relations
description: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah highlighted the challenges in normalizing ties with Pakistan, emphasizing the spike in terrorism and ineffective civilian leadership in Islamabad. He urged Pakistan to take concrete actions against terrorism, noting the historical tensions rooted in Jammu and Kashmir's choice to join India.

title: Jammu and Kashmir's Path to Terror-Free Future: A New Dawn?
description: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha of Jammu and Kashmir announced that significant regions in India, including the northeast, have become free of terrorism. Local recruitment into terrorist organizations is shrinking, though challenges persist with cross-border infiltration allegedly from Pakistan. Sinha emphasizes collective societal effort to combat extremism.

title: Opinion | Why China Should Return Aksai Chin, Give Up Claims On Arunachal, And Stop Arming Pakistan
description: Pariksith Singh outlines bold geopolitical strategies for Xi Jinping and Trump, emphasizing India's pivotal role in future global alliances.

title: R Sridhar Takes Helm as Sri Lanka's Fielding Coach Till 2026
description: Former India cricketer R Sridhar becomes Sri Lanka's fielding coach until 2026 T20 World Cup. Known for enhancing players' natural athleticism, Sridhar aims to harness Sri Lanka's innate skills. His appointment follows a coaching reshuffle due to fielding issues in prior matches, supporting upcoming series against Pakistan and England.

title: Pakistan Extends Airspace Ban For Indian Aircraft Till January 23, India Likely To Reciprocate: Report
description: Pakistan extends airspace ban for Indian aircraft till January 23 after the Pahalgam attack. India may reciprocate to Pakistan's latest NOTAM.

title: China, Pakistan’s Closest Ally, Seeks ‘Closer Defence Ties’ With India - What New Delhi Said
description: China is seeking to strengthen defense relations with India, but India remains cautious about such overtures. While China desires increased military exchanges, including bilateral visits and potential joint exercises, India prefers a more measured approach due to past conflicts, notably the Galwan clashes. , India News, Times Now
